description: Find pairs of guides whose single-strand nicks land on OPPOSITE strands within a chosen distance — the design that turns two Cas9 nickases into one defined double-strand break with a chosen overhang. Two nicks on the same strand are two independent single-strand events and excise nothing, so only opposite-strand pairs are offered. Reports each pair's signed offset (positive = 5' overhang, negative = 3'), the interval between the nicks, and each guide's own score. Cas9-family (3'-PAM) nucleases only: Cas12a's staggered cut is a different geometry and is refused rather than approximated. A custom PAM can be searched with customPam / customGuideLength.

circular.description: Read the molecule as a circle, so the offset takes the short way round and a pair straddling the origin is found.

customGuideLength.description: Spacer length for a customPam, 15–30 nt.

customPam.description: Search a PAM this table does not carry, in IUPAC codes (1–8 nt, e.g. "NG", "NNGRRT"). Combined with customGuideLength and customPamSide this defines a custom nuclease. An invalid character is refused by name rather than matching nothing.

customPamSide.description: Where a customPam sits relative to the spacer. Only 3prime is modelled for nick pairs.

limit.description: Cap on returned pairs, ranked by the two guides' combined score then by increasing overhang length.

maxOffset.description: Furthest apart the two nicks may be, in bp (0–100). A design choice, not a measurement: nothing in the literature fixes where two nicks stop being one lesion.

minOffset.description: Closest the two nicks may be, in bp. 0 permits a blunt pair.

minScore.description: Only consider guides with a heuristic score at least this high (0–100).

nickase.description: Which Cas9 nickase variant, i.e. which domain the mutation killed. D10A kills RuvC and nicks the TARGET strand; H840A kills HNH and nicks the PAM strand. The two give different pairs from the same molecule, so this is not cosmetic.

nuclease.description: Cas9-family nuclease id whose 3' PAM the guides are found by. Ignored when customPam is given.

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence (raw or FASTA; IUPAC accepted).

name: crispr_nickase_pairs
title: Paired nickase designer
